executionModel.portableSkillExecution: A skill can be run by an agent from its own cwd as instructions plus readable and writable files, manifests, metadata, and generated artifacts.
executionModel.clashManagedExecution: Clash can optionally host the same workflow as managed actions that register assets, fill metadata, preserve provenance, gate review, and apply canvas/timeline projections with CAS.
executionModel.hardBoundary: The skill owns the workflow and artifact contract; Clash owns collaboration and project-state management. A missing Clash system capability must not prevent portable skill execution.

marketplaceSemantics.hostCapabilityContract: Skills depend on named host capability contracts, not Clash private storage or UI internals. Clash is one host implementation that provides collaboration, permissioning, asset registry, metadata fill, provenance, review gates, and CAS apply.

artifactContract.skillOwnedWorkspace: The agent owns its cwd as a draft workspace and may read/write declared project files, actions, assets, metadata, manifests, schemas, and projections there before explicit apply.
artifactContract.forbiddenDependencyPolicy: Portable skills must not depend on snapshot.bin, SQLite rows, Loro documents, canvas private node state, runtime secrets, or any other Clash-private storage surface; managed Clash execution must expose those changes through public action, metadata, asset, and CAS projection contracts.

marketplaceSemantics.systemCapabilityMeaning: requiredSystemCapabilities is a compatibility field for Clash-native automation bindings needed for fully managed execution. These capabilities are not required to run a skill as a portable file/artifact workflow outside Clash.

statusPolicy.ready: ready means the skill has a runnable local CLI/action contract with contract tests proving its declared production artifacts, metadata, assets, or view projections.
statusPolicy.blockedBySystemGap: blocked-by-system-gap skills must list systemGaps with a capability, concrete missing behavior, and unblockSignal for Clash-managed execution.

Automatic OCR/logo detection, color sampling, material verification, and review UI remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: ComfyUI runner contract
systemCapabilities.description: clash production plan-comfyui-workflow plus apply-metadata registers a pinned local ComfyUI workflow file, computes workflow/output hashes, records model and custom-node lineage, preserves input slot mapping, projects clash.image.comfyui-runner.projection, and attaches per-output image.comfyui-output metadata as local assets. It does not execute ComfyUI, install models/nodes, manage queues, or validate generated pixels; host execution and visual QA remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Image embedding store
systemCapabilities.description: clash production plan-image-embedding-store plus apply-metadata registers existing local image embedding vector files, verifies vector dimensions, stores vector path/hash/model/distance metric metadata, projects clash.image.embedding-store.projection, and attaches per-asset image.embedding metadata for identity/product/scene/style/logo baselines. It does not execute embedding models; backend runners, similarity search indexes, threshold calibration, and review UI remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Storyboard CAS projection
systemCapabilities.description: clash production project-storyboard-timeline projects storyboard panel assets into a CAS-required timeline view; project-storyboard-prompt-pack records the editable prompt-pack version in cwd state, apply-storyboard-prompt-pack consumes it implicitly with stale-write rejection, and replace-storyboard-prompt-pack creates a versioned copy-on-write projection without moving existing downstream references. Editable storyboard host UI/apply integration remains missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Content provenance credentials
systemCapabilities.description: clash production plan-content-credentials plus apply-metadata registers a local unsigned or externally signed content-credentials manifest, computes target/ingredient/optional C2PA manifest hashes, writes provenance.content-credentials metadata, and projects clash.provenance.content-credentials.projection under projections/provenance. It does not sign C2PA manifests or create content credentials; c2patool integration, signing identity, and export embedding remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Open-source license ledger
systemCapabilities.description: Tracks third-party reference licenses, integration policy, NOTICE obligations, and review-required sources before code/model/tool reuse.

systemCapabilities.title: Production action runner
systemCapabilities.description: Local CLI action runner is a Clash-managed adapter for portable file/artifact skill workflows, with repo-hosted marketplace action contracts for representative production primitives. It validates pipeline manifests, applies AssetMetadataFillAction, composition route plans, review stage gates, dry-run cost gates, semantic reference role plans, product/logo QA plans, analysis backend benchmark plans, image embedding store plans, audio stem separation plans, ComfyUI workflow plans, content credentials plans, MG specs/snapshots/video exports, derived-overlay projections, beat analysis, lyrics alignment, visual moment libraries, MV beat-cut timeline projections, ad delivery/packshot metadata, ad visual frame extraction manifests, ad visual pixel evidence, ad visual QA plans, text-cut plans/media exports, caption sidecar exports, timeline CSV handoffs, reference-review plans, controlled reference download plans/executions, reference non-copying QA, storyboard consistency QA, storyboard prompt-pack CAS projections, and storyboard timeline projections into metadata/assets/projections/rights without mutating canvas; pipeline validation checks action/metadata/asset/projection/review/export artifact coverage and CAS-required projections, route plans forbid silent runtime fallback, dry-run gates do not execute providers, semantic references carry copy-on-write requirements, controlled reference download execution keeps raw media quarantined and does not grant final export rights, product/logo QA fails closed on locked reference evidence, ad visual frame extraction uses explicit local ffmpeg and writes manifests, ad visual pixel analysis reads only local PPM frame samples, ad visual QA plans do not execute OCR/logo/pixel analysis backends, analysis backend benchmarks do not execute backends, image embedding stores register existing vector files without executing models, audio stem separation registers existing stem files without executing separation backends, ComfyUI workflow plans register pinned workflow/output lineage without executing ComfyUI, content credentials plans register unsigned/external manifests without signing C2PA, review approvals use path-bound cwd observations, and MG/derived-overlay/MV beat-cut/storyboard prompt-pack/storyboard timeline projections declare explicit apply boundaries with host-managed implicit CAS, including COW prompt-pack replacement from the same observed version. Provider execution, project DB integration, multi-user review UI, and managed timeline apply orchestration remain separate.
